in_sanskrit.name: Hanu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Jaw, mouth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hanu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Hanu is derived from Sanskrit, where it means 'jaw' or 'mouth'. In Hindu mythology, Hanuman, a powerful monkey god, is named after this term as he is known to have an unbreakable jaw and an eloquent mouth. He is considered a symbol of strength, devotion, and wisdom.
